changelog:
Initial release of Machine Config Migrator.

- Enables safe migration of configurations for tmux, Vim/Neovim, Emacs, Zsh, Alfred, Git, and SSH across machines.
- Allows users to select components for backup and restore, with plugin-aware transfer options.
- Supports both suggest and automatic modes for plugin (re)installation.
- Provides dry-run mode for safe verification before applying changes.
- Excludes sensitive SSH artifacts like private keys by default; emphasizes backup safety.
- Offers clear workflow and usage instructions for both collection and restore processes.
summary: Migrate workstation configuration from an old machine to a new one with selectable components and plugin-aware transfer. Use when users ask to backup, move,...
